question_for_G: Does G accept polisyos.runtime.http as an additional public_stable supported entrypoint, or keep it internal and direct owners to remove/qualify the existing “Public entrypoints” contract in its package README?

recommended_choice.basis: The parent contract explicitly says HTTP subpackages remain internal unless separately documented. The dedicated HTTP README separately labels the module public entrypoints and names the exact facade. The actual lazy facade resolves seven names to canonical owner objects. This makes the smallest contract change consistent with the existing policy carve-out.
recommended_choice.decision: Add polisyos.runtime.http to supported_entrypoints of the existing public_stable polisyos.runtime package. Do not move the seven names to the parent polisyos.runtime facade.
